aethel_region_overview.name: The Aethel Region
aethel_region_overview.inspired_by: The rugged, beautiful landscapes of Alaska.
aethel_region_overview.creation_myth: The Legend of the Two Hearts: In the beginning, there was a single, dreaming consciousness of the world. This mind dreamt of two concepts: Life and Stillness. These dreams became the two hearts of the world: Yggdrys, the Verdant Heart, the embodiment of chaotic growth and connection; and Fimbulstorm, the Hoarfrost Heart, the embodiment of perfect, silent stasis. Aethel is the land where these two dreams are most potent, a place where the unrelenting cold and the tenacious life that clings to it are in a constant, delicate balance.
core_themes: The balance between creation and cessation, life and stillness.
The enduring legacy of the past.
The journey of self-discovery in a harsh, untamed wilderness.

key_locations.name: Veridian City
key_locations.description: The bustling heart of the Aethel region, a rare pocket of true urban development nestled at the edge of the vast wilderness. It's a city of contrasts, where ancient traditions meet cutting-edge, often reckless, technology. The city is a hub for all of the region's major factions, making it a hotbed of political intrigue, corporate espionage, and cultural exchange.

key_locations.name: The Grand Glacier
key_locations.description: A colossal river of ice that dominates the northern landscape, crisscrossed with deep crevasses and ice caves. It is a place of profound silence and immense power, the slumbering place of the Hoarfrost Heart, Fimbulstorm.

locusZone.name: The Great Stillness
locusZone.effect: While on the Pinnacle, all sound-based moves fail. All Ice and Psychic-type Pokémon gain +1 to their VIT and INS scores. Trainers recover all spent Resonance points after a full night's rest.

key_locations.name: The Bellowing Vents
key_locations.description: A geothermally active volcanic area in the southern mountains, characterized by steaming geysers, bubbling mud pots, and rivers of heated water. It's a dangerous but resource-rich area, fiercely contested by Cryosys and the Prospector's Union.

key_locations.name: The Ancestral Bluffs
key_locations.description: Towering cliffs along the western coast, riddled with ancient burial caves and marked with petroglyphs that tell the forgotten stories of Aethel's first peoples. This area is sacred to the Aurora's Chosen and is a place of deep spiritual power.

locusZone.name: Echoes of the Ancients
locusZone.effect: While on the Bluffs, Ghost and Rock-type Pokémon have advantage on Stealth checks. Trainers recover 1 Resonance point after an hour of quiet contemplation.

key_locations.name: Port Lumina
key_locations.description: A hardy, salt-of-the-earth port town that serves as the gateway to Aethel's treacherous northern seas. Its people are resilient and deeply connected to the ocean, and it's the primary stronghold of the Coastal Clan.

key_locations.name: Oldgrowth Haven
key_locations.description: A mystical and ancient part of the forest, protected by Rowan and his Grass-type Gym. It is said to be directly connected to the roots of Yggdrys itself.

locusZone.name: Heart of the Living Network
locusZone.effect: While within the Oldgrowth Haven, all Grass and Fairy-type Pokémon are considered to have the 'Regenerator' ability. Trainers recover 1 spent Resonance point for every hour they rest here.

aethel_narrative_arcs.description: The ultimate threat to Aethel is the subversion of the planet's natural balance. Chairman Thorne of Cryosys believes the chaos of life is a flaw to be corrected. His plan is to hijack the divine power of the slumbering Hoarfrost Heart, Fimbulstorm, to force a premature and permanent winter upon the world. He seeks to create a new world of perfect, silent, and frozen order, silencing the dream of life forever.

key_acts.title: A Region on Edge
plot_points: Players begin their journey and are introduced to the simmering tensions in Aethel.
They witness Cryosys's aggressive energy extraction at the Bellowing Vents, a key part of their plan to gather the power needed for the awakening ritual.
The immediate threat seems to be a geological disaster, masking Cryosys's true intentions.

key_acts.title: Heart of the Geyser Fields
plot_points: Cryosys's large-scale energy extraction at the Bellowing Vents pushes the legendary Pokémon Terrin to the brink of a full eruption.
The players must navigate the conflict and calm the rampaging 'Shifting Earth.'
Upon succeeding, they uncover Cryosys's deception: the entire operation was a cover to siphon immense geothermal energy and channel it north to the Grand Glacier, where the true target lies.

key_acts.title: The Hoarfrost Heart
plot_points: Armed with the terrible truth, the players must race to the heart of the Grand Glacier to stop Chairman Thorne and Cryosys.
They must confront Subject Zero, the Aethelian Mewtwo, and sever its psychic connection to the awakening Fimbulstorm.
The final confrontation is to soothe the prematurely roused Hoarfrost Heart back to its natural slumber, preventing the world from being plunged into a perfect, silent, and frozen eternity.

aethel_faction_reputation.system_description: The player's actions will influence their standing with the major factions of the Aethel region. Reputation is tracked on a scale from -10 to +10, unlocking different interactions, quests, and rewards.

canon_clarifications.clarification: The Aethelian variants of starter Pokémon from other regions (e.g., Bulbasaur, Chimchar, Popplio lines) are not offered as official starter choices by Professor Aspen. They are rare creatures that exist in the wild and must be discovered through exploration, making the native Aethel starters (Fawnora, Emberling, Kragshell) unique to the player's initial journey.

aethelian_resonance_mechanic.description: A rare phenomenon unique to the Aethel region where the profound bond between a Trainer and their Pokémon allows them to harmonize with the region's ambient energy, unlocking a temporary and powerful new form.
